plan.english: Woman, where is the ford? The ford is over there, under the great oak. Is the water deep? Now it is not deep: in summer the river is small. Will my horses cross? They will cross. Lead them toward the big stone, and do not go beyond the stone. You are dear to me, woman, and I will give you copper. May the river guard you!

plan.english: Uncle, is this your boat? It is my boat. My father made it from an old oak. Is it older than you? It is older than I. It held my grandfather, and now it holds my sons. Will you carry me down to my mother's village? Step into it and sit down; do not stand up! I will not stand up: I am afraid of the river. Do not tremble!

What shall we two buy with the hides? Knives and a cauldron. Our mother wants a new cauldron. Then row, and I will sing! Sing, and the gods will hear us.
